title: Business responses and risk buffers need separate tests

source.label: Original event and PQD tests 原事件与PQD检验

metricDefinitions.label: Event screening
metricDefinitions.definition: Seven prespecified daily signals, four passed the original event gate. GSD and MBSD had no candidate passing both original gates; NSCC had two preliminary funding candidates.

filters: Original frozen analysis through 2026Q2; three CCP clearing services
caveats: Exploratory small-sample checks; no causal or calibrated risk model.

source.label: Supplemental response diagnostics
filters: GSD/MBSD/NSCC separately; 2020Q4–2026Q2; extension after original results were observed

metricDefinitions.label: Supplemental response diagnostics
metricDefinitions.definition: Spearman rho for same-quarter lag 0 and next-quarter lag 1; ordinary BH q within all 294 comparisons per sample; moving-block CI for n>=12.

caveats: Post-result exploratory analysis; later sample already seen and only six quarters.
BH uses ordinary p-values; serial dependence and business scale remain material.
Quarter aggregates cannot identify event-day impacts; ratios have timing and denominator limitations.
